title: Shipments
purpose: Find shipments of distributed specimens and follow each from preparation to receipt.
summary: Shipments of distributed specimens, followed from preparation to receipt.

tasks.title: Start a shipment
steps: Open the approved request and select New shipment there.

tasks.title: Find a shipment
steps: Type the SH or RQ number, tracking number or institution in [[Search]].

good_to_know: Shipments start from requests, so this list has no New button.
Receipt shows the condition as corrected, or Not yet recorded after dispatch.
[[Specimen]] under More filters finds shipments that hold or sent that specimen.

sections.title: What the page shows
paragraphs: Each row is one shipment, numbered SH-000001 and up, newest first. A shipment is started from an approved request with picked specimens (New shipment on the request), so this list has no New button. It moves from Draft to Packed to Dispatched to Receipt recorded; a draft or packed one can be Cancelled. The Shipments and Returns tabs switch between this list and returned specimens.

Every role can read this list. Type in the search box to narrow the rows, use the filters beside it and under More filters, and choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page (25 by default). Active filters appear as chips you can remove one by one; Clear all removes them all. The sort and filters are kept in the address, so a view can be shared. A filter value that is not valid shows no rows rather than all of them. Changing a filter returns you to the first page.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches the shipment number (SH-000003 or 3), the request number (RQ-000012), part of the tracking number or of the ship-to institution. The default sort is Shipment, newest first. Sortable columns are Shipment, State, Request, Ship to, Packed and Dispatched.

items.label: State
items.description: Any state (the default), In preparation (draft or packed), or one state.

items.label: Specimen
items.description: Under More filters. A specimen ID; lists shipments that contain it (draft or packed) or sent it. The specimen record links here with this filter set.

items.label: Shipment
items.description: The number; opens the shipment. Always shown.

items.label: State
items.description: Draft, Packed, Dispatched, Receipt recorded or Cancelled.

items.label: Ship to
items.description: The recipient institution recorded on the shipment.

items.label: Specimens
items.description: Specimens in it now, or sent once dispatched.

items.label: Packed, Dispatched
items.description: When it was packed and dispatched.

items.label: Receipt
items.description: The condition of the recorded receipt (as corrected), or Not yet recorded for a dispatched shipment.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads the rows that match the current search, filters and sort as a UTF-8 CSV file, with exact amounts and times in the repository's time zone. Every role that can read the list can download it. A selection of more than 10,000 rows is refused rather than cut short: narrow the filters and export again. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe. Each download is recorded with who exported which selection and how many rows, never the file itself.

items.label: Nothing matches these filters
items.description: Change or clear the search and filters.
